rss_scope: Process peak through service, independent replay and class export.

replay.scope: Published winners, paired outcomes and selection among fully covered classes. Partial trials and class enumeration are outside this replay.

domain_policy.advancement: Every enumerated cost slice is reported in difficulty_values.

proof_scope.eligibility_only: Reviewed mundane template/material combinations do not imply ownership or access.

assumptions: Birth and combat draws are shared examples. Their frequencies describe this panel.
Ordinary solo enemies use declared stationary positions, melee attempts and hostile spell schedules.
Training targets, lodging, funding and later equipment opportunities are hypothetical. The creation fight uses owned items.
limitations: The recommendation covers the pinned game snapshot and supported ordinary PvE. Different drops, opponents or combat settings can change the choice.
Class generation and the set of progression and casting policies are bounded.
